I understand the R250 participation fee must be paid via EFT and that my spot is only confirmed once proof of payment is received via WhatsApp.

events.title: AI Prompt Party
events.description:
AI Prompt Party is a first-of-its-kind experience bringing together creators, innovators, artists, and digital pioneers who are using artificial intelligence to redefine the future of creativity. From music generation to prompt engineering and live competitions, this is the space where imagination meets technology and anything becomes possible.

Create smarter. Compete harder. Build the future.

Good food. Great company. Unexpected connections.

Because sometimes the perfect match starts around the table.

events.description:
Step into an electrifying nightlife experience where artificial intelligence takes over the decks and the dancefloor comes alive. AI Dance Night brings together cutting-edge technology, futuristic sounds, incredible visuals, and an unforgettable party atmosphere designed for those ready to experience the next generation of entertainment.

Dance to the future. Experience what's next.
